WITH group_rates AS (
    SELECT
        s.riskeval,
        AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate
    FROM scans AS sc
    JOIN sites AS s
      ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
    GROUP BY s.riskeval
),
benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM group_rates
),
above_benchmark AS (
    SELECT gr.rate, b.avg_rate
    FROM group_rates AS gr
    CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
    WHERE gr.rate > b.avg_rate
)
SELECT
    AVG(rate) AS average_rate,
    AVG(rate - avg_rate) AS average_excess
FROM above_benchmark;
